    Published March 21, 2024 in First Block

    First Block with Notion Co-Founders Ivan Zhao and Simon Last

    By Anastasia Crew

    Startup Marketing Lead

    1 min read
    Share this post

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    Listen to the First Block podcast Spotify, Apple, or your favorite podcast platform.

    To learn more about how Notion is supporting startups, please visit notion.com/startups.

    Welcome to First Block, a Notion series where founders and executives from the world's leading companies tell us about the many “firsts” of their startup journeys. Hosted by our Co-founder Akshay Kothari, this series explores the many ups and downs that founders face as they build their companies, and what they've learned along the way.

    For our final episode of First Block Season 1, Akshay sits down with Notion co-founders Ivan Zhao and Simon Last to talk about everything Notion — where we started, how we got where we are now, and where we’re headed.
